title: SELF: A Robust Singular Value and Eigenvalue Approach for LLM Fingerprinting
abstract: arXiv:2512.03620v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safeguarding the Intellectual Property (IP) of Large Language Models (LLMs) against model theft represents a critical challenge in contemporary AI research. Although fingerprinting is essential for establishing forensic evidence for model derivation, existing methods are susceptible to false claim attacks, weight manipulations, or high false positive rates, undermining their utility. To overcome these limitations, we propose SELF, \rev{a novel intrinsic weight-based fingerprinting scheme tailored for robust IP forensics via adversarial model lineage verification}. SELF eliminates dependency on input and inherently resists false claims, achieving robust \rev{provenance detection} through unique, scalable and transformation-invariant fingerprint extraction via singular value and eigenvalue decomposition of LLM attention weights. translated_title: SELF：一种用于大语言模型指纹识别的鲁棒奇异值与特征值方法
translated_abstract: 保护大语言模型（LLM）的知识产权（IP）免受模型窃取是当代人工智能研究中的一个关键挑战。尽管指纹识别对于建立模型衍生的取证证据至关重要，但现有方法容易受到虚假声明攻击、权重操纵或高误报率的影响，从而削弱了其实用性。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SELF，这是一种新颖的基于内在权重的指纹识别方案，专门用于通过对抗性模型谱系验证实现鲁棒的知识产权取证。SELF消除了对输入的依赖，并且天然能够抵抗虚假声明，通过对LLM注意力权重进行奇异值和特征值分解，提取独特、可扩展且变换不变的指纹，从而实现鲁棒的来源检测。实验结果表明，SELF在保持较高的知识产权侵权检测准确率的同时，显著（摘要截断）。
tldr: SELF是一种基于LLM注意力权重奇异值与特征值分解的内在指纹识别方案，无需输入依赖即可抵御虚假声明攻击和权重操纵，实现鲁棒且可扩展的模型知识产权取证。
en_tdlr: SELF is an intrinsic weight-based fingerprinting scheme for LLMs that extracts unique, scalable, and transformation-invariant fingerprints via singular value and eigenvalue decomposition of attention weights, enabling robust input-free IP forensics resistant to false claim attacks and weight manipulations.
